The Office of the Secretary shall consist

Franchising Review Staff and the Investi-

The Franchising Review Staff shall be
headed by a Review Staff Director with the
same rank, salary and privileges of a Depart-
ment Regional Director who shall be appointed

the Secretary.
The Franchising Review Staff
shall assist the Secretary in the review of
cases and matters pertaining to, among others,
grants of franchises and the regulation thereof.
The Investigation, Security and Law
Enforcement Staff shall be headed by a Staff

security and intelligence for the Department;
